name: Pettigrew
role: Member of the Dakota territorial council
bio: Pettigrew sat in the Dakota territorial council in 1885, serving on the rules committee. The paper of March 12, 1885 reported that he argued for calling Steele before a council committee, and that in the capital debate a mock amendment drew laughter at his expense before he moved the previous question.
